Northwind Robotics

Software Engineering Intern, Perception (Summer 2027)
Pittsburgh, PA · Hybrid · Internship
Apply now    Save

About Northwind Robotics
Northwind Robotics builds autonomous inventory robots for warehouses. Our fleet of
800 robots scans shelves nightly for 40 retail partners.

About the role
As a Software Engineering Intern on the Perception team, you will help our robots
see. You will work with senior engineers on object detection and shelf-label reading.

What you'll do
- Train and evaluate computer vision models in PyTorch
- Write production Python and C++ for on-robot inference
- Build tools to label and visualize sensor data

What we're looking for
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- Graduating between December 2027 and June 2029
- Experience with Python; C++ is a plus
- Coursework or projects in machine learning or computer vision

This is a 12-week paid internship starting June 2027. Pay: $45-$55/hour.
